title.narrative: ICMPD. Modernizing immigration service workforce in Nigeria. 2021-2024.

description.narrative:
The overall objective of the project is to support the Nigerian Immigration Service in its institutional reform effort to modernize its Human Resource Management System to increase internal efficiency, productivity, and fairness among its workforce. As such the project is building the capacity of Nigeria to improve the administration of measure related to the movement of persons through a strengthened institutional framework. The objective is addressed in the three following ways:
1) To design a well-structured, scalable, secure, and integrated architecture (E-HRM system for the project to meet the organizations Human Resource needs(
2) To deploy the solutions provided making it easily accessible to all necessary users
3) Provide technical and practical expertise to ensure seamless transition of the HRIS and over all user experience
